Priya / Anna —

Quick note from finance: Redwood (US entity) typically treats EU-registered vendors as follows for services delivered to our EU customers or for EU-based contracts:

- If vendor supplies services and has a valid EU VAT number (USt-IdNr), we can apply the reverse charge mechanism in most cases and the supplier invoices net of VAT. We will need a copy of the VAT certificate on file.
- If services are delivered to Redwood US (or invoiced to the US entity) and no reverse charge applies, the vendor should include VAT on the invoice; Redwood will not be able to reclaim EU VAT paid.

Action items for LunaTech:
1) Send completed Vendor_Onboarding_Form.pdf with IBAN/BIC and legal entity name exactly as registered.
2) Attach the VAT certificate (we received the PDF but need the scan of the official registration page).
3) Confirm which Redwood entity (US or EU/EMEA arm) will be named on the contract/PO for this engagement. If you expect POs to be issued to the EU entity, we will route through our EMEA accounting unit and reverse charge can normally be applied.

I'll review the sample invoice and confirm whether the current scope qualifies for reverse charge. For timing — once onboarding + VAT cert are in place we can issue the PO within 3 business days.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Finance | Redwood Inference
